Strategy: Exponential-decay peak at twice the item size: score is the negative exponential of the distance between a bin's residual and 2*item, so the preferred bin leaves exactly one item-sized gap while near misses decay smoothly and far bins are punished steeply. It can fail when the steep decay makes the rule chase the peak bin even when a tight bin would close cleanly.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-exp(abs(r - 2 * item) / 50.0) for r in bins]
```
